subject.title: fix(telegram): suppress reconnect drain re-entry while delivery is in-flight

question: Should Telegram receive drain metadata through a backward-compatible additive seam, or may `drainPendingDeliveries` change its published Plugin SDK return contract?
rationale: The PR needs metadata across the plugin boundary, but the current approach changes an existing third-party API and repository policy requires explicit ownership of that compatibility decision.

options.title: Preserve the existing contract
options.body: Keep `drainPendingDeliveries(): Promise<void>` and expose the result through an additive callback or separately approved narrow seam.

options.title: Approve the return-type change
options.body: Intentionally adopt `Promise<ReconnectDrainResult>` with aligned SDK documentation, API baselines, compatibility tests, and explicit upgrade rationale.

recommendation.title: Preserve the existing contract
recommendation.body: Keep `drainPendingDeliveries(): Promise<void>` and expose the result through an additive callback or separately approved narrow seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest recent history is their work on Telegram live-claim recovery and polling drain behavior.
